ideas.pitch: An interactive, low-latency voice-powered navigation and guide agent built specifically for navigating the Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College campus during the hackathon.
ideas.title: AetherVoice Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Voice AI Track sponsored by ElevenLabs, leveraging sponsor APIs to win a less-contested track prize.

ideas.pitch: An engineering team lifecycle intelligence platform that automatically captures architectural decisions and code notes from team chats and commits during the 24-hour sprint.
ideas.title: DevSingularity Knowledge Capture
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of a top-place developer tools hackathon winner by targeting a pain familiar to student developers and hackathon organisers.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-enabled AI health awareness chatbot tailored for rural and semi-urban communities in Punjab, offering localized preventive care and vaccination tracking.
ideas.title: RuralPulse AI Health Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features clear, measurable social impact addressing regional healthcare accessibility, a key metric for judges looking for real-world utility.

ideas.pitch: An automated code review and mentorship grading pipeline that hooks directly into student repositories to prepare teams for CodeCrafters VIP membership challenges.
ideas.title: CodeCrafters VIP Prep Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the CodeCrafters VIP membership tracks by building tools that facilitate advanced software engineering mastery.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative vibe-coding workspace designed for freshers and student teams at GNDEC to co-create, share snippets, and crowdsource debugging in real time.
ideas.title: CampusHive Co-Coding Space
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aims directly at the Best Freshers Team and Best Girls Team tracks by solving onboarding hurdles for beginner builders with exceptional UI/UX polish.
